title: Figma token layouts outside the explicit-header claim
summary: A value on the line after the header name, a credential-shaped value under a longer header name, and a bare figd_ or figp_ string in prose.
rationale: The bounded claim is the exact header with the value on the same line. These layouts may still leak a credential, but nothing here settles whether they are credentials, and Figma states no format that would let a bare figd_ or figp_ string be recognised without a carrier.

expectation.rationale: No outcome is asserted. The layouts are frozen as unsupported variants of the explicit-header claim: a consumer neither gains nor loses a point on them. Figma's pages read state no prefix, alphabet or length, and the figd_ and figp_ prefixes rest on scanner-rule artifacts only.

sources.supports: passing the token to the API in the X-Figma-Token header of your request.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
